name: reposage
description: RepoSage: local-first, evidence-grounded GitHub repository auditing with deterministic scoring and dual-runtime Gemma 4 analysis.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace=@reposage/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@reposage/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@reposage/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@reposage/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@reposage/api && npm run build --workspace=@reposage/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
